title: AMB+ reaction morphology replicates on seed 3: region B 34 round droplets, passive 23, region C a worm labyrinth (2 components); 0 persistent splits, 0 motion
summary: Fresh seed 3 at the default reaction (u=3e-4, phi_t=-0.2), t=3000, labkit. Region B (zeta=-1.6, lam=-0.8): 34 round, near-monodisperse droplets that do not coarsen (B/sheet.png), 1 split, 0 persistent. Passive (0, 0): 23 droplets at the end (max 34), 11 merges. Region C (+1.6, +0.8): droplets elongate and merge into a worm labyrinth, 2 components at the end, 29 merges (C/sheet.png). No droplet moved >= 1 body length in any arm (max 0.3-0.7 BL).

observations.F: B/sheet.png 34 round droplets; P/FACTS.md 23 droplets, 11 merges; C/sheet.png labyrinth, 2 components; 0 persistent splits and max 0.7 BL in all three

controls_run.F: P/ (passive zeta=lam=0) and C/ (opposite-sign arm), same seed and reaction

verdicts.limitation: One reaction setting; I used labkit counts, not the author's CV and aspect measures. The finding is a morphology control, not a capability.
